definition: the part you get when something is divided
description: A picnic on the grass by the beach. A woman with pink hair opens a pizza box on her lap, lifts out a slice with the cheese stretching, and holds it out to the friends sitting around her. A jogger stops and takes a piece, and an older woman walking two dogs is offered one as well. In a wide shot the whole group sits on blankets in a circle, each of them eating their own slice while the open box stands in the middle.

taps.phrase: to share her pizza with everyone
to walk two dogs on leads
